description: Get the status of a conversion by its id, for example one that was still running when convert_file returned. With output_path, a finished result is downloaded to that local path (several results get -1, -2, ... before the extension). output_path may be an existing directory (the result gets a default name there); without an extension the target extension is added. Repeating the call continues an interrupted download: complete files that are already there are kept, the rest is downloaded. Results are kept for 24 hours after the conversion.

id.description: Conversion id from convert_file or convert_url.

output_path.description: Local file path to save the result to, for example /home/me/report.pdf.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at output_path. Default false.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, in seconds (default 600). If the conversion is still running then, the answer contains the conversion id for get_conversion.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the conversion to finish (default 0).

name: get_conversion
title: Get a conversion
